1. CLIENT will pay NPSA $28,000 upon execution of this Engagement Letter. This fee includes the combined costs below.

   By agreement of the parties, this fee shall be paid in three (3) installments as follows:
       1. $11,200 (40%) at signing
       2. $8,400 (30%) month 4
       3. $8,400 (30%) month 8
   (a) If CLIENT provides written notice of cancellation after executing this Agreement and prior to NPSA delivering a completed grant application ready for submission, the Agreement will be cancelled but no refunds will be issued.

B. Third-Party Grant Writer

1. CLIENT will pay a third-party grant writer for grant writing services. These costs are not listed in this Engagement Letter because CLIENT must contract directly with the third party grant writer outside of NPSA's direction or control to remain in compliance with NSGP rules.

Note: None of the above costs are reimbursable from grant funds.
